design: Paired ablation: current prompt versus current prompt with only target context removed. Not a replay of every deployed prompt difference.
journalist_packets: Frozen Influencer relevance-trial evidence, rendered by current Journalist selector; not a representative sample of all news.
classifier_selection: One headline per entity selected before runs; identity and recorded background frozen for both variants.
classifier_metadata: Canonical identity plus recorded attributes rendered as background; no inferred gender or affiliations.
baseline_contract_versions: Kept equal to candidate only for fixture harness compatibility; baseline binaries built from isolated source with context injection removed.
